abilities.name: FORCEFUL COMMAND
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: The target cannot use MOVE abilities. The target’s melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) .

abilities.name: MIGHTY WALLOPER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: TIMBERRRRR!
abilities.effect: When the MEGA-GARGANT in this regiment of renown is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off . The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

abilities.name: SHAKE THE EARTH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is INFANTRY , double the amount of mortal damage inflicted. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: TIMBERRRRR!
abilities.effect: When the MEGA-GARGANT in this regiment of renown is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off . The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points: The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3. It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: MERCENARY ATTITUDES
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly NON-UNIQUE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit: You can re-roll run rolls for the target. Add 1 to charge rolls for the target. The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks . Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks . Add 10 to the target’s control score .

abilities.name: ON DA MOON’S TRAIL
abilities.effect: The melee weapons of units in this Regiment of Renown have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are contesting an objective you control .

abilities.name: SUPPLIES DONT COME CHEAP
abilities.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown . Each friendly unit wholly within 3" of that terrain feature is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, Heal (X) the target, where X is an amount equal to the roll.

abilities.name: NO ONE RIDES FOR FREE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit with up to 10 models that is wholly within 9" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: LONG-RANGE SUPPORT
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 15" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and that no friendly units are contesting . Each unit contesting that objective is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: PUNISHMENT FITS THE CRIME
abilities.effect: You believe the ‘Accusations of Regicide’ DELUSION (see Grand Justice Gormayne ’s warscroll).

abilities.name: SNEAKY PROWLIN’
abilities.declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve prowlin’ around . They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: AMBUSH TIME!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown if they are prowlin’ around .
abilities.effect: Set up those units anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SKEWER IT AGAIN!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by a shooting attack made by the Beast-skewer Killbow in this Regiment of Renown . Then, pick any number of Man-skewer Boltboyz units in this Regiment of Renown to focus fire .
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the ranged weapons used by the units you picked to focus fire but all of their attacks must target the enemy MONSTER you picked.

abilities.name: SNEAKY DISTRACTION
abilities.declare: Pick the Gobbapalooza in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

abilities.name: SUPER-SECRET TUNNELS
abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in a super-secret tunnel . It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: SUDDEN EMERGENCE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If the Rabble-Rowza in this Regiment of Renown is in a super-secret tunnel , pick it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other friendly units that are in a super-secret tunnel within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: GOROAN FORGECRAFT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly DESTRUCTION HERO that is within the combat range of a HERO in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
abilities.effect: On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: BELLOW OF GORKAMORKA
abilities.declare: Pick the Ogroid Thaumaturge in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has STRIKE-LAST until the start of your next turn. In addition, while the target has the BURNING keyword, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: INCUBATION PERIOD
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown .
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve festering within . They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: BURSTING WITH LIFE
abilities.effect: If a friendly non- NURGLE’S GIFT unit would be destroyed, before the last model is removed from play, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly non- NURGLE’S GIFT unit that has been destroyed this battle. On a 5+, pick a friendly unit that is festering within and set it up wholly within 6" of that model. It can be set up in combat .

abilities.name: GO DAT WAY!
abilities.declare: Pick the Dankhold Troggoth in this Regiment of Renown to be the target if it is within 12" of the Loonboss in this Regiment of Renown.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can still use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: TAKTIKAL COWERING
abilities.effect: While the Loonboss in this Regiment of Renown is within the combat range of the Dankhold Troggoth in this Regiment of Renown: That Loonboss has WARD ( 4+ ) . Each time you make a successful ward roll for that Loonboss , allocate 1 damage point to that Dankhold Troggoth after the damage sequence for that Loonboss has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: PROJECTILE VOMIT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn. Then, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of this unit and pick all other units (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: BELLOWING MOCKERY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn, then pick an enemy unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: WHAT’RE YOU LOOKIN’ AT?
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it charged this turn and has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn. Then, pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can pass through enemy models and must end that move in combat with the target.
